name: holy-grail-mcp
description: MCP server exposing the Holy Grail catalog — sites, Chrome extensions, MCP servers, and AI skills — as read-only tools and resources

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run snapshot && bun run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild scripts/standalone-entry.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/http-bundle.mjs --log-level=warning --banner:js="// Generated by \`bun run bundle\` (packages/mcp) — self-contained MCP server for the Vercel function. SDK + catalog snapshot inlined. Do not edit."
